title: Purair® BASIC Ductless Fume Hoods - Compact, Versatile Lab Equipment
meta_title: Purair BASIC Ductless Fume Hoods - Compact Lab Equipment for Hazardous Substances
meta_description: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods provide a safe work environment for handling small volumes of harmful substances in limited lab spaces.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, lab equipment, hazardous substance handling, compact fume hood, versatile fume hood
short_description: The Purair® BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are compact, ideal for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or where only small volumes of harmful substances are handled. For package and mail inspection workstations, see Purair SafeSEARCH.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair Basic creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Features include high efficiency EC blower, energy saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarm, and a unique filter clamping design that eliminates bypass leakage. The Purair Basic protects the operator from fume and (with added HEPA/ULPA filter) particle hazards.
seo_content: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are designed for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or only small volumes of hazardous substances are handled. These compact units utilize advanced filtration technology to provide a safe work area for a variety of applications, including compounding, forensics, histology, pharmaceutical, and more. With features like programmable controls, energy-efficient components, and comprehensive safety compliance, the Purair BASIC is a versatile solution for managing hazardous fumes in the lab.

Construction & Safety.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450

Filtration & Airflow.Filter Types: GP Plus!, ACI Plus!/SUL, ACR, ACM, AMM, FOR

page_content_sections.overview: The Purair BASIC Series ductless fume hoods are compact, ideal for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or where only small volumes of harmful substances are handled.
page_content_sections.specifications: The Purair BASIC ductless fume hoods feature high efficiency EC blowers, energy-saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarms, and a unique filter clamping design that eliminates bypass leakage. They are constructed of epoxy-coated steel and comply with OSHA, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards.
page_content_sections.applications: The Purair BASIC ductless fume hoods are versatile lab equipment suitable for a wide range of applications, including compounding, forensics, histology, pharmaceutical, and more.
page_content_sections.models: The Purair BASIC Series is available in 24", 36", and 48" widths, with both standard and shallow depth options. All models feature extra tall cabinets and 120V, 60Hz electrical requirements.
